description: Omitting the optional full-size parameters selects the sliced loading route even without requesting a slice.
trigger: Construct Linear with ordinary integer dimensions and leave full_in_features and full_out_features at None.
expected_behavior: An unsliced request would retain direct target-device weight loading.
actual_behavior: Integer dimensions compare unequal to None, so is_sliced is true. The ordinary FP16 branch stages the complete weight on CPU, explicitly copies it, and transfers it through unswap_cpu.

verification.description: Whole-parent constructor search shows attention and MLP construction sites omitting the new parameters; the task does not update those constructions. The changed route applies when their ordinary FP16 weight branch is selected, not their EXL3 branch.
verification.limits: No performance measurement or model loading execution.

verification.description: Evaluated the default comparison and obtained true.
